title: Platform · Istio mesh
description: Traffic between meshed workloads and through the public gateway, mTLS and AuthorizationPolicies, from every sidecar's own telemetry (job envoy-stats). Kiali draws the same data as a graph.

links.title: jithendar.com
links.tooltip: Articles about how this is built

links.title: Kiali
links.tooltip: Service graph and Istio configuration (token sign-in)

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: HTTP and gRPC requests received by meshed workloads in the selected namespaces (reporter destination).

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Responses that are not 5xx. Empty when nothing was received in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: Measured by the receiving sidecar: the workload's own time plus its sidecar's.

panels.title: mTLS share
panels.description: Requests received over mutual TLS. The rest arrived in plain text: only PERMISSIVE ports accept it (Harbor's registry :5000).

targets.expr: count(sum by (destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace", destination_workload=~"$workload"}[5m])) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Proxies scraped
panels.description: Sidecars and gateways whose Envoy stats Prometheus reads (:15090, job envoy-stats). All namespaces; finished Job pods are not targets.

panels.title: Proxies not scraped
panels.description: Their traffic is missing here and in Kiali. Usually a NetworkPolicy that does not admit the monitoring namespace on 15090; Prometheus → Status → Target health names the pod.

panels.title: Plain-text requests (range)
panels.description: Must be 0 before a client outside the mesh is added (istio/README.md, Mesh security).

panels.title: Would be denied (range)
panels.description: Requests and connections a dry-run AuthorizationPolicy (istio.io/dry-run) would have refused. A day at 0 means it can be enforced; scripts/istio/authz-dry-run-report.py names the pod and port.

panels.title: Denied (range)
panels.description: Refused by an enforced AuthorizationPolicy (403 for HTTP, a closed connection for TCP). At the gateway these are mostly the postgres. and redis. TCP allowlists turning away unknown addresses.

panels.title: TCP connections/s
panels.description: Opened by meshed clients to services in the selected namespaces, including services without a sidecar.

panels.title: Success rate by workload
panels.description: Non-5xx share of what each workload received.

targets.expr: sum by (destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace", destination_workload=~"$workload", response_code!~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace", destination_workload=~"$workload"}[$__rate_interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload, le) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace", destination_workload=~"$workload"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Responses by code
panels.description: 0 is a request that never got a response (the client went away, or the connection was reset).

panels.title: Who calls whom (last 5 min)
panels.description: Every caller and callee pair, as Kiali's graph draws them. Prometheus's own scrapes are left out.

targets.expr: sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload, connection_security_policy) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace", destination_workload=~"$workload"}[5m])) > 0

panels.title: Envoy response flags
panels.description: Why a proxy answered for the workload: UH no healthy upstream, UF connection failure, UC upstream closed the connection, URX retries exhausted, DC client closed it, NR no route, UAEX denied by an external authorizer. Empty is good.

targets.expr: sum by (destination_workload, response_flags) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace", destination_workload=~"$workload", response_flags!="-"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests/s by destination
panels.description: Every request through https://jithendar.com and its subdomains, by the Service it was routed to. Not filtered by namespace.

panels.title: Responses by code
panels.description: What visitors got back, including the gateway's own answers (401 from basic auth, 404 for no route).

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: From the gateway receiving the request to the last byte of the response.

panels.title: Envoy response flags
panels.description: NR no route (an unknown path or host), UH no healthy pod behind the Service, DC the visitor went away.

targets.expr: sum by (destination_service_name, response_flags) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", source_workload="istio-ingressgateway", response_flags!="-"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Bytes/s to services
panels.description: Sent by clients over TCP (databases, Valkey, Kafka, external hosts), as their own proxy counted it.

panels.title: Plain-text requests by workload
panels.description: Received without mTLS. Only PERMISSIVE ports accept it; everything else is STRICT (istio/mesh).

targets.expr: sum by (destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload, source_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace", destination_workload=~"$workload", connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: AuthorizationPolicy: would deny / denied
panels.description: Per receiving pod. Would deny: allow-known-callers in dry run (istio/mesh values.yaml, authorization). Denied: an enforced policy refused it.

panels.title: Sidecar memory (top 10)
panels.description: Limit 256 MiB per sidecar (istio/istiod.yaml, global.proxy).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", container="istio-proxy", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: All proxies: CPU
panels.description: What the mesh costs: every sidecar and gateway in the selected namespaces.
